title: Flow cytometry-based invasion phenotyping assay for malaria
protocol: Add 12 mL of RPMI 1640 and 0.5 mL of washed RBC to a 50 mL tube to obtain a 2% hematocrit and mix gently.
Transfer 3 mL of 2% hematocrit RBC suspension to a 15 mL tube labeled “stained RBC” and centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate and discard all supernatant from the centrifuged tube.
Add 3.1 mL of RPMI 1640 to a 15 mL tube labeled “CFDA” or “DDAO.”
Add 12.4 μL of 5 mM CFDA SE in DMSO or 6.2 μL of 5 mM DDAO SE in DMSO to the respective “CFDA” or “DDAO” tube and mix thoroughly.
Add 3 mL of prepared dye solution (20 μM CFDA SE or 10 μM DDAO SE) to the “stained RBC” tube and immediately pipette the suspension up and down thoroughly to resuspend the pellet.
Place the tube on a rotator, switch on the rotation at maximum speed.
Incubate the tube at +37°C for 2 hours.
Centrifuge the “stained RBC” tube at 450g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate and discard all of the supernatant.
Add 3mL of complete media and pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate and discard all of the supernatant.
Add 3mL of complete media and pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Place the tube on a rotator, switch on the rotation at maximum speed.
Incubate the tube at +37°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate and discard all of the supernatant.
Add 3mL of incomplete media and pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate and discard all of the supernatant.
Repeat steps 16 to 18 once more.
Aspirate and discard all of the supernatant.
Add 3mL of incomplete media and pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Transfer 400μL of cell suspension from the “stained RBC” tube to each of 6 microfuge tubes labeled “A” to “F”.
Add 8μL of 1U/mL neuraminidase in RPMI 1640 to tube B and tube E.
Place the 6 tubes on a rotator, switch on the rotation at maximum speed.
Incubate the tubes at +37°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the microfuge tubes on a benchtop microcentrifuge for 30 seconds.
Aspirate and discard the supernatants.
Add 400 μL of incomplete media to each of the 6 tubes.
Centrifuge on a benchtop microcentrifuge for 30 seconds.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each of the 6 tubes.
Add 400 μL of incomplete media to each of the 6 tubes.
Resuspend the cell pellets by pipetting up and down.
Add 2 μL of 10 mg/mL trypsin in RPMI 1640 to tube C.
Add 40 μL of 10 mg/mL trypsin in RPMI 1640 to tube D.
Add 40 μL of 10 mg/mL trypsin in RPMI 1640 to tube E.
Add 40 μL of 10 mg/mL chymotrypsin in RPMI 1640 to tube F.
Place the 6 tubes on the rotator, switch on the rotation at maximum speed.
Incubate at +37°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the microfuge tubes on a benchtop microcentrifuge for 30 seconds.
Aspirate and discard the supernatants.
Add 400 μL of incomplete media to each of the 6 tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes on a benchtop microcentrifuge for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps 12 and 13 once more.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each of the 6 tubes.
Add 400 μL of complete media to each of the 6 tubes.
Resuspend the cell pellets by pipetting up and down.
Label 18 wells of a 96-well, round-bottom plate, on its lid, from A to E and from 1 to 3.
Add approximately 200 μL of PBS to the 78 unlabeled wells of the plate.
Add 50 μL of donor pRBC at 2% hematocrit, 1-2% parasitemia, to each of the 18 labeled wells A1 to F3.
Rotate the plate 180 degrees.
Add 50 μL of target RBC at 2% hematocrit to each of the corresponding wells.
Mix by pipetting up and down the contents of each well, avoiding bubble creation.
Place the plate inside an incubator culture chamber pre-warmed to +37°C.
Close the chamber and gas it for 3 min with a mixture of 1% O2, 3% CO2, and balance N2.
Incubate the chamber at +37°C for 48 hours.
Centrifuge the assay plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 50 μL of culture supernatant from each well.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each well and centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each well.
Add 200 μL of 2% paraformaldehyde/0.2% glutaraldehyde in PBS to each well, pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Incubate at +4°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each well.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Centrifuge the plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of 0.5 mg/mL ribonuclease A in PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Incubate at +37°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of 1:5,000 SYBR Green I in PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellet.
Incubate at +37°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge the plate at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Centrifuge at 450g for 3 minutes.
Draw and discard 200 μL of supernatant from each of the 18 wells.
Repeat steps 22 and 23 twice more.
Add 200 μL of PBS to each of the 18 wells.
Pipette up and down to resuspend the cell pellets.
Label 18 wells of a 96-well, flat-bottom plate from A1 to F3 on its lid.
Add 250 μL of PBS to each of the 18 labeled wells.
Draw 25 μL from each of the 18 wells containing stained cells and add this to the corresponding wells in the new plate with only PBS.
Pipette up and down to mix the diluted cell suspension.
Acquire the plate containing the diluted cell suspension on a flow cytometer fitted with appropriate laser lines.
Acquire 100,000 events to have at least 50,000 target cells for analysis.
